newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HKR group wins HK airport-related project.
newsitem.headline: HKR group wins HK airport-related project.

text.p: A consortium led by HKR International Ltd has won development rights to the second-phase residential project at Tung Chung station along Hong Kong's airport railway, the Mass Transit Railway Corp (MTRC) said.

The MTRC expects to sign the development agreement this month with the consortium, which also includes Hong Leong Holdings Ltd, Recosia Pte Ltd and Hongkong China Ltd, it said in a statement sent to Reuters on Friday.
The development is estimated to cost about HK$9 billion.
HKR, Hong Leong and Recosia will each own 30 percent of the project, and Hongkong China 10 percent, an HKR executive said by telephone.
Hong Leong and Recosia are Singaporean concerns, she said.
The consortium expects to arrange a syndicated loan to finance the project, she said.
Hong Kong is building a railroad to link its new airport to various districts in the territory. The airport is scheduled to be operational in 1998.
The Tung Chung second-phase development has a gross floor area of 2.04 million square feet.
The consortium had met all of the tender requirements and offered the best financial terms to the MTRC, the MTRC statement said.
